# CNBuilder AI Guide

- **Stack & routing**: Next.js 16 App Router with client components; entry pages are [app/page.tsx](app/page.tsx) (forms list), [app/builder/page.tsx](app/builder/page.tsx) (designer), and [app/preview/page.tsx](app/preview/page.tsx) (CareNotes preview). UI styled with Tailwind v4; drag-and-drop powered by @dnd-kit (droppable ids: `form-canvas`, `section-<id>`, `row-<id>`), icons via lucide-react.

- **Data model**: Form structure is Section → Row → Widget per [types/form.ts](types/form.ts); each Section has `cols` controlling the grid. Forms persist to Supabase table `forms` (columns id, name, description, widgets JSONB, updated_at) via [lib/supabase.ts](lib/supabase.ts); `widgets` column stores the `sections` array verbatim.

- **Auth gate**: Supabase Authentication with email/password; login page at [app/login/page.tsx](app/login/page.tsx). Auth functions in [lib/supabase.ts](lib/supabase.ts) include `signUp`, `signIn`, `signOut`, and `getCurrentUser`. All pages check authentication and redirect to `/login` if not authenticated. Forms track creator with `created_by`, `author_email`, and `author_name` columns.

- **Dev workflow**: `npm run dev` to serve, `npm run build`/`start` for prod, `npm run lint` for ESLint. Required env vars in `.env.local`: `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`.

- **List page flow**: [app/page.tsx](app/page.tsx) loads forms with `loadAllForms`, routes to `/builder?formId=...` for edits, and deletes via `deleteForm`. Export button is stubbed.

- **Builder layout**: Toolbar controls form name plus `replannable`/`confirmable` toggles; left library ([components/WidgetLibrary.tsx](components/WidgetLibrary.tsx)), center canvas ([components/FormCanvas.tsx](components/FormCanvas.tsx)), right properties panel ([components/PropertiesPanel.tsx](components/PropertiesPanel.tsx)). Suspense wrapper keeps search params working.

- **Widget creation & naming**: Dragging from the library creates a widget with autogenerated `fieldName` (timestamp + random) capped to 30 chars; Properties panel can regenerate deterministic names with type-specific prefixes (e.g., `chk_...`, `ddl_...`) and enforces 30-char limit plus duplicate detection.

- **Canvas/grid rules**: Section `cols` drives CSS grid columns; each widget has `colspan` with +/- controls constrained to section cols. Rows can be added/deleted; selecting section/row/widget controls which properties are editable. **CRITICAL**: When multiple widgets are placed in the same row, the XML generator MUST split them into separate `<row>` elements if their combined colspan exceeds the section's `cols` value. Each XML row's total colspan (sum of all label and field colspan attributes) MUST exactly equal the section's `cols` attribute.

- **Widget properties**: Common flags include `required`, `hideLabel`, `additionalInstructions`, `readOnly` (for TEXT_INPUT, TEXT_AREA, NUMBER, DECIMAL, DATE, TIME). Type-specific settings: options arrays for radio/dropdown, `checkboxLabel` and `groupName` for checkboxes, numeric min/max, textarea rows, action button `actionDescription`, instruction note `instructions`, label color/weight.

- **Save/Load**: `saveForm` upserts `sections` into `widgets` column; new forms get `crypto.randomUUID` id and URL is replaced with `formId`. `loadForm` maps `widgets` back to `sections`.

- **XML export path**: Toolbar Export uses [lib/xmlGenerator.ts](lib/xmlGenerator.ts) → `generateCareNotesXML`, then downloads as `${formName}.fdl`; alert reports developer note count. **IMPORTANT**: Picklists are NOT embedded in XML - they are managed separately in CareNotes System Administration. Developer notes list which picklists to create.

- **XML generation rules**: 
  - **Row splitting**: When generating XML, widgets are grouped into rows. If the total colspan of widgets in a row would exceed `section.cols`, a new `<row>` element MUST be started. Each label takes 1 colspan, each field takes (widget.colSpan - 1) colspan.
  - **Label requirement**: Every `<field>` element MUST have a preceding `<label>` element in the same row. Empty labels (`<label caption="" colspan="1" />`) are used when no visible label is needed.
  - **Comments placement**: XML comments (including developer notes) MUST be placed OUTSIDE of `<row>` elements, never between `<label>` and `<field>` tags.
  - **LABEL widgets**: Inject full-width label + hidden field in separate row.
  - **ACTION_BUTTON widgets**: Render as `<action>` with `<event>` child, NOT as `<field type="Button">`. Actions get their own row with full section colspan.
  - **INSTRUCTION_NOTE**: Becomes developer comments only, not rendered in XML structure.
  - **Checkbox groups**: Share one label plus individual fields keyed by `groupName`.
  - **Picklists**: For radio/dropdown, emit developer notes listing picklists to create in CareNotes System Administration (prefix: `UDP_`). Do NOT embed `<picklist>` elements in the XML.
  - **Read-only fields**: Emit developer note comments with JavaScript to set fields read-only: `ControlStateManager.ToggleElement("", "field_name", true, false, true, false);` or `GetControl("field_name").disabled = true;`

- **CareNotes color palette** (defined in [lib/colors.ts](lib/colors.ts)):
  - **System colors** (CareNotes UI, not user-editable):
    - Button borders & dark blue backgrounds: `#1a5993`
    - Alert/warning background: `#ffe1e1`
  - **Form colors** (defined by ClaireNotes/users):
    - Label background (light blue): `#e7edf9` - used in canvas, XML cellstyle, and preview
    - Confirmed status: `#46f600`
    - Unconfirmed status: `#ff0000`
  - **ACG brand colors** (for user-created elements):
    - Button background (Coral): `#EF6024`
    - Button border (Orange): `#F0941F`
    - Teal: `#196774`
    - Charcoal: `#363432`
    - Sage: `#90A19D`

- **Preview page** ([app/preview/page.tsx](app/preview/page.tsx)): Replicates CareNotes read-only view with exact header styling (Cancel/Edit buttons with #1a5993 borders, patient info bar with #1a5993 background). Shows form as it would appear in CareNotes with proper label backgrounds (#e7edf9) and read-only field styling.

- **Replan/Confirm features**: If `replannable`, XML adds Replan button plus `Replan` field with standard exclude attributes and warnings; `confirmable` adds `<webusercontrol name="Confirm" />`. `viewproperties` is always generated with form name.

- **Known constraints**: Field names and option strings are expected ≤30 chars (per README); keep labels concise to avoid exceeding CareNotes limits. Default section starts with 2 columns and one section; builder enforces login before access. **CareNotes validation**: Will reject forms where row colspan totals don't match section cols, or where fields lack preceding labels.

- **CareNotes Form Definition Language (FDL) reference**: Full 92-page documentation available at `/mnt/user-data/uploads/Carenotes_Form_Definition_Language__FDL_.pdf`. Key sections:
  - Section 4.16: `<field>` tag attributes (name, type, colspan, mandatory, max/min, picklistname, style, cellstyle, etc.)
  - Section 4.18: `<action>` tag for buttons (uses `id` not `name`, `text` not `caption`, requires `<event>` child)
  - Section 9.3.1: `ControlStateManager.ToggleElement()` for read-only fields via JavaScript
  - Read-only fields have NO XML attribute - must be set via JavaScript in OnLoad/OnAfterFormInitialise events

- **Extending**: When adding widget types, update enum in [types/form.ts](types/form.ts), library catalog, canvas renderer, properties panel, and XML mapping in [lib/xmlGenerator.ts](lib/xmlGenerator.ts) to keep drag/drop, editing, and export aligned. Remember to handle row splitting logic and ensure proper label/field pairing in XML output.

Let me know if any area needs more detail or if conventions are missing.
